title: GIG-3189: Ignore Invalid Postmaclone Rules On Up And Down
description: Loads docker, setup, and custom commands even when the postmaclone section fails validation, so ngramx up/down are not blocked by anonymizer schema errors.

test_plan.description: Invalid postmaclone rules do not block config load or custom commands
steps: Confirm a yml with valid docker plus core_activity_logs.context: {} loads docker and artisan, and sets postmacloneError
Confirm Application registers the artisan command and does not record a config load error
